title: Elevate UI Readability: Master CSS 'line-height' for Superior Web Font UX
tweet: Boost your web typography! Optimal CSS 'line-height' drastically improves readability & UI comfort. Learn the golden rules for perfect spacing between lines. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign #UX
tip: The 'line-height' property is a silent hero of web typography, profoundly impacting readability and user experience. Insufficient line-height makes text dense and hard to follow, while excessive line-height can break visual coherence. For most body text, a value between 1.4 and 1.7 is a good starting point, often expressed as a unitless multiplier relative to the font-size. This ensures consistent spacing regardless of the element's font-size, improving accessibility and visual flow across different screen sizes and devices. Pay attention to how line-height interacts with paragraph spacing to create comfortable reading blocks.
